entities.summary: Charlotte "Lotti" van der Gaag was a Dutch sculptor and painter and strongly associated with members of the COBRA arts movement. Lotti van der Gaag was a painters & sculptors from The Hague (1923-12-18, The Hague–1999-02-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
